summary: Completed E2E browser testing for Phase 53 surface + Phase 56A behaviors. Successfully tested full lead-to-customer conversion chain, provisional cost banner, unfilled cost rows display, and critical tab landing behavior. Identified one minor issue with BPHTB acronym in provisional banner.

design_issues.issue: Provisional cost banner shows 'BPHTB' as acronym instead of fully human-readable text. While BPHTB is a well-known Indonesian property tax acronym, Phase 56A specification requires NO code names. Banner text: 'masih SEMENTARA — BPHTB, Biaya notaris / akad, Biaya bank (provisi, admin, blokir, materai), Asuransi jiwa & kebakaran, PPh penjual belum diisi'
design_issues.note: Other cost names are correctly human-readable. Only BPHTB appears as acronym. Consider changing to 'Bea Perolehan Hak atas Tanah dan Bangunan (BPHTB)' or similar.

passed_tests: US-56-1 (CRITICAL): After 'Jadikan Pembeli', page correctly lands on 'Kontrak & Legal' tab - URL contains ?tab=kontrak53, tab panel has data-tab='kontrak53', contract panel visible with contract number KTR/2026/0034
US-56-1: Full chain executed successfully - Lead creation → Unit reservation (A-03, Rp 850M) → Booking confirmation → Customer conversion with KPR scheme
US-56-2 (MOSTLY PASS): Provisional banner shows human-readable cost names (notaris, akad, bank, provisi, admin, materai, asuransi, jiwa, kebakaran, pph, penjual) - only BPHTB appears as acronym
US-53-2: Unfilled cost rows correctly show 'Belum diisi (bukan nol)' in italic format - NO rows showing 'Rp 0' incorrectly (7 unfilled rows verified)
Login and navigation flows working correctly for manager@sipro.co.id
Contract creation and display working correctly
Test data properly prefixed with 'POC53 E2E' for cleanup

Remaining tests require multi-user session management (finance@, sales@) which encountered session handling issues in automated testing.
